reservoir_ep16_001.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_001.text: On One Thousand Two Hundred Sixteen, Yue walked to the low choice desk with Fu beside her. The two accepted water-project plans lay where Qiu had left them after the owners' actual ratification. Their separate thirty-copper source had arrived, and Yue's six ordinary record duties already belonged to the course wage schedule. She could choose consented household comparison or physical maintenance records. Each plan had work she wanted and a concern it would leave unanswered. Fu kept the promised quiet until Yue asked for an ordinary breath of time.

reservoir_ep16_002.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_002.text: Qiu read the owners' current conditions once. The comparison role would receive limited anonymous interval and sleep observations, with private employer papers excluded and no physical bay repair purchased. The maintenance role would receive actual ordinary work and operating notices, with no private diary access and no claim about unmeasured sleep improvement. The current water timetable remained unchanged under both plans. A later supported staffing decision would be needed before another opening. Yue could select a real project without promising its result would authorize every future household request.

reservoir_ep16_003.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_003.text: She asked the ordinary receiver to show the six course duty dates again: Nineteen, Twenty-four, Twenty-nine, Thirty-four, Thirty-nine and Forty-four. Each accepted eight-hour equivalent paid three after actual completion, eighteen in all from the existing course line. The role changed the sources and physical opportunities inside those days. It did not add wages or hours because one plan sounded more compassionate. Qiu waited while Yue checked the map against her modest practice and later examination. The registered qualifying series remained months ahead, after real work and recovery.

reservoir_ep16_004.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_004.text: The adult daughter came to the desk with her limited diary scope, folded separately from the private employer paper she had never offered. The Ren receiver brought the ordinary bay plan with its accepted fitting height. Neither asked Yue to choose their concern by declaring the other trivial. The daughter wanted an actual question about sleep answered within her own consent. The receiver wanted ordinary cleaning to stop requiring the awkward cover and wet exit. Yue heard them both and felt the choice grow harder because she no longer imagined either request as a convenient summary.

reservoir_ep16_005.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_005.text: Fu asked whether Yue wanted to explain her preference before giving the actual answer. Yue said she wanted to name it clearly once the plan was selected, without a speech that made the waiting people approve her. The two households would live with the unchosen concern after her six days ended. A careful explanation could help them understand; it could not obligate them to feel satisfied. Fu nodded and moved to the ordinary waiting chair. She had agreed to accompany a friend, not become another receiver whose approval the choice must earn.

reservoir_ep16_006.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_006.text: Deng had observed Yue's ordinary current condition that morning. No headache or new shoulder pain had appeared, and the known low-table duty range remained appropriate. There was no new physical clearance attached to the project. Yue would use ordinary hands, actual reading and safe known movement. Qualified household observers or the qualified maintenance worker would perform their own accepted tasks. The useful division let a candidate contribute without becoming the answer to every need. Her quiet-room seventy-two remained its own measured morning, and her stage remained seven.

reservoir_ep16_007.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_007.text: Jing placed the material estimates beside the plans. Eight coppers bought the comparison's actual dated forms and ordinary containers under one choice, or the maintenance's accepted low fitting and channel supplies under the other. Four paid dispatch under comparison, or delivery under maintenance. The eighteen paid different actual workers. The same received purse could make two distinct futures possible, but could purchase only the selected one. Yue touched neither material list as if it already existed. The actual order would follow her accepted answer.

reservoir_ep16_008.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_008.text: Outside, Tian walked past carrying a sound basket and a completely unimportant onion. He had purchased the onion for the kitchen and wished both women good luck before remembering they disliked vague prophecies. He amended the wish to a useful ordinary lunch afterward. Fu laughed and accepted on Yue's behalf only because the meal had already been their plan. Yue smiled, then returned to the desk. Her friends could make the morning gentler while the households' actual competing concerns remained sharp enough to require an answer.

reservoir_ep16_009.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_009.text: Qiu asked one final practical question: which unchosen opportunity would Yue stop requesting inside this interval? Yue understood why it mattered. Selecting comparison meant leaving the physical cover unchanged and not inventing unpaid repair afterward. Selecting maintenance meant letting the private diary remain inaccessible and not seeking it through friendship. A role could be meaningful only if its boundary actually closed something she wanted. She looked at the daughter and Ren receiver, then at the two accepted sources. The loss she chose to carry would become part of the project, not an omitted footnote.

reservoir_ep16_010.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_010.text: She remembered the family journey's completed fare, actual work and missed conversation. That choice had not become painless after it was made. It had become usable dates people could arrange their lives around. This project would need the same honesty. Yue set her own ordinary duty sheet beside the plan she intended to accept and asked Qiu to record one finite role. The owners waited without applauding a decision they had not yet heard. She spoke the work she would actually do.

reservoir_work_choice.speaker: narrator
reservoir_work_choice.text: Yue can receive the household comparison: limited anonymous collection and sleep observations, with the awkward bay left unrepaired. Or she can receive the qualified maintenance work: a changed fitting and channel, with the private diary unavailable and sleep effects unmeasured. Both use the same six paid ordinary duty days and separate thirty-copper project source. Both have the owners' bounded ratification. Yue must select one source of work and leave the other useful opportunity for a later actual decision.

choices.text: Receive the consented household comparison; gain limited diary access and leave the physical bay unrepaired.
Receive the qualified maintenance work; change the bay and leave the private sleep diary unavailable.

reservoir_work_compare.speaker: narrator
reservoir_work_compare.text: Yue accepted the consented household comparison role. Qiu recorded its six actual duty dates and limited source, and the adult daughter signed her own diary scope beside the accepted aggregate plan. The private employer paper remained excluded. The Ren receiver signed that the current physical cover would not be repaired under this project. Yue said plainly she wanted to understand the actual time cost and would not promise a later unfunded repair to make today's loss easier. The receiver nodded without pleasure. The chosen work had begun with a real cooler relationship.

reservoir_ep16_013.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_013.text: On Two Hundred Seventeen, the ordinary receiver purchased the accepted eight-copper comparison materials from the project's thirty. Their dated forms and ordinary containers were actually received and checked by the named custodian. Two of the four reserved dispatch coppers sent the initial scope copies to their accepted household destinations. Twenty remained after the ten actually spent: eighteen for performed observation work and two for the approved final dispatch. No physical fitting had been purchased, and no borrowed qi sleeve entered the water project because it happened to be available nearby.

reservoir_ep16_014.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_014.text: The two household observers confirmed their actual four-hour attendance on each of the six project dates. Each day used two ordinary two-hour windows including preparation, permitted observation and accepted source checking. Six dates would make twenty-four hours apiece, with three-copper installments after each completed eight hours. Their pay funded the work, not the daughter's private testimony. She could withdraw a private entry before its agreed receiver copied it. The observers agreed to name that absence rather than guess the sleep time from a neighboring entry.

reservoir_ep16_015.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_015.text: Yue visited the Ren bay under its current public physical scope before the first comparison day. The awkward cover and wet exit remained. The receiver lifted the cover through her familiar ordinary method and asked whether a diary would move it. Yue answered no. The word felt harsher aloud than it had on the plan. She did not soften it with an invented volunteer worker. The receiver said she would complete her accepted observations anyway, because understanding the timing could still be useful. Disappointment and actual cooperation remained in the same person.

reservoir_ep16_016.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_016.text: On Two Hundred Eighteen, the daughter prepared her first limited diary entry and asked Yue to repeat who would read it. The named receiver would handle the anonymous durations and actual sleep onset; public aggregate release required the owners' later approval. No employer pay paper would be copied. The daughter corrected one phrase that made her broad night-work account look like a fixed private shift. Yue amended it before the first field day. The correction protected the source instead of merely making the daughter feel heard while retaining the unwanted wording.

reservoir_ep16_017.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_017.text: Tian asked whether the project forms wanted a fish. Yue refused because the accepted aggregate pages needed clear dated intervals without unrelated decoration. He accepted that ordinary boundary and drew the fish on his own lunch wrapping. The daughter saw it and laughed briefly, then kept her private page folded. Yue appreciated the laugh without treating it as broader consent. A person could enjoy the same absurd creature and still restrict who read the details of her work and sleep. Friendship offered company; the role offered only its named source.

reservoir_ep16_018.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_018.text: On One Thousand Two Hundred Nineteen, Yue began the first actual eight-hour comparison duty. Her morning four-hour receiving interval included the observer's accepted preparation, current Liang morning draw and source checking. Twelve actual litres were collected under the unchanged six-o'clock mark. The daughter's limited account recorded twenty-eight minutes of collection work and return, with sleep onset at seven-four. Earlier public estimates had called it ten minutes. Yue preserved the actual offered duration and its particular date. One observed morning did not prove every night-work day had the same cost.

reservoir_ep16_019.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_019.text: The household observer's own morning two-hour window completed its accepted actual attendance. The daughter could offer a sleep entry later within the finite scope; the observer did not remain beside her bed or acquire a private workplace file. Yue received the permitted entry after the owner's actual confirmation. She wrote that collection time and sleep onset were different marks. A person could return home before falling asleep. The distinction mattered more than the convenient story that lighter water would automatically turn every saved minute into another minute of rest.

reservoir_ep16_020.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_020.text: During Yue's evening four-hour duty interval, the ordinary observers checked the current Liang twelve-litre evening draw and Ren's single twenty-four-litre source. The actual cleaning lasted thirty minutes, with twelve consumed by the awkward cover and eight by the wet exit's ordinary handling. Those measured durations belonged to the agreed current observation, not a qualified repair estimate. The public totals remained twenty-four for each household. No extra six-litre opening occurred at eighteen-forty-five. Its overlap with cleaning remained a proposed conflict, visible without being acted out through an unauthorized draw.

reservoir_ep16_021.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_021.text: Yue completed the actual eight-hour equivalent and received three coppers from the existing course wage line after its accepted source check. The two household observers had each completed four actual hours, half their first eight-hour equivalent. No observation installment was yet due under their accepted payment schedule. Yue kept their work record separate from her own wage acknowledgment. The project's actual field day had supplied durations that both supported and complicated the hoped-for sleep improvement. Her useful role was to preserve those complications, rather than choose the figures that justified her earlier preference.

reservoir_ep16_022.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_022.text: At supper the adult daughter asked whether Yue thought the project proved the morning load should be lighter. Yue said it had shown one actual collection cost and one later sleep onset, with more agreed dates ahead. It had not yet measured the proposed lighter morning draw because that timetable had not been ratified or staffed. The daughter looked disappointed, then agreed the distinction was fair. Yue could hear how much she wanted a simple helpful conclusion. She had chosen comparison partly from curiosity; she would have to remain faithful when its answer was less pleasant.

reservoir_ep16_023.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_023.text: On Two Hundred Twenty, Deng kept the ordinary lesson modest after yesterday's split duty. Yue reported real fatigue and no headache or new shoulder pain. They performed fewer safe familiar sets, each with full grounding and the old input ceiling. She had been awake early for the household source and would not hide that condition because the work felt important. Jing issued no new reserve result from the lesson. The current body would be independently compared after actual recovery, not made larger by the fact that her records might help somebody else.

reservoir_ep16_024.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_024.text: Fu visited the Ren receiver that afternoon and later asked Yue whether she wanted to hear the woman's criticism. Yue did. The receiver thought the comparison would mostly prove what everyone already knew, while the cover would still bruise her knuckles. Yue could accept the specific criticism without claiming the observer's paid cooperation meant she approved the choice. Fu said she had also heard the receiver ask a sharper question about actual cleaning duration. The relationship had not become one mood. Yue would meet the real question at the next accepted receiving hour.

reservoir_ep16_025.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_025.text: On Two Hundred Twenty-one, the receiver asked that question herself. The field form had separated cover time and exit handling, but a margin note joined them as twenty minutes of 'avoidable delay.' She had not called them avoidable under the current physical condition. Yue traced the phrase to her own hopeful summary and removed it. The durations remained actual; avoidability required the unperformed repair or another measured method. The receiver accepted the correction and remained disappointed. Yue had repaired one misuse of evidence without purchasing affection through the result.

reservoir_ep16_026.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_026.text: The ordinary project receiver kept the corrected private limited page with its actual source, not on the public board. The approved aggregate would later include only the owners' accepted wording. Yue had gained access to the question she wanted and discovered that access carried responsibility for unflattering corrections. She had wanted the diary and now had to live beside its inconvenient evidence. It required her to retract a convenient conclusion in front of a person whose useful physical need she had left unanswered. She went to the kitchen hungry and less certain she deserved to be thanked.

reservoir_ep16_027.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_027.text: Tian offered ordinary company at the lunch table and asked whether the river onion had made any administrative errors. Yue said it had recently misclassified twenty minutes. Jing warned them that the onion should consult its actual source before wearing a crown. Their joke let Yue admit embarrassment without exposing the daughter's private diary. She shared only the public lesson that an observed duration did not prove it was avoidable. The room held a friend correcting herself, not a perfect cultivator arranging other people into evidence of her wisdom.

reservoir_ep16_028.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_028.text: On Two Hundred Twenty-two, the two observers checked their ordinary preparation for the next date. Each had four actual hours still to complete before the first three-copper installment. One observer needed to alter an unrelated private appointment. The project receiver accepted her current four-hour attendance commitment after she confirmed the alternative arrangement herself. Nobody assumed the household woman could abandon another task because this project sounded beneficial. Yue retained the actual accepted source and left the private appointment unrecorded. The finite role required attendance, not ownership of every reason behind it.

reservoir_ep16_029.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_029.text: The daughter prepared the next limited sleep entry and decided to disclose only a different ordinary household noise, without identifying its private family cause. Yue accepted that scope. A change in actual sleep onset could then be recorded beside unchanged collection work without being forced into a single water explanation. The diary would have an unanswered cause, and the aggregate would have to say so. Yue liked the clarity and found it emotionally unsatisfying. She had wanted a measured relationship simple enough to produce a clean recommendation. Real testimony could refuse that simplicity.

reservoir_ep16_030.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_030.text: On Two Hundred Twenty-three, the Ren receiver showed Yue a new scrape on the unchanged cover. It had appeared during ordinary cleaning after the first observed day. The qualified physical inspection remained available as its public source, but no repair money had been selected. Yue did not draw more input or try an untested force to compensate. She asked whether the ordinary condition notice had reached the actual owner. It had. The owner would restrict unsafe use if the condition worsened. Her project could hear this real consequence while leaving its physical solution outside the selected fund.

reservoir_ep16_031.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_031.text: One Thousand Two Hundred Twenty-four brought the second actual comparison duty. The morning accepted source again showed twelve litres at six under the unchanged timetable. The daughter's offered collection-and-return duration was twenty-seven minutes, and sleep onset came later than on Nineteen despite the slightly shorter collection. Her limited entry named ordinary household noise without identifying its private cause. Yue recorded the actual date and scope. Two mornings now undermined the easy claim that a saved collection minute always became a saved sleep minute. They did not make the collection burden irrelevant.

reservoir_ep16_032.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_032.text: The evening four-hour receiving interval checked the current draws and actual cleaning observation. The cover time remained difficult, and no new extra opening had occurred. Both household observers completed another four actual hours, reaching eight apiece across the two accepted dates. Each received the first three-copper installment after the ordinary receiver checked the actual attendance and sources, six paid together from the project line. Yue then completed her own eight-hour equivalent and received three course wage coppers. Separate work and separate pay had occurred under the chosen comparison, without purchasing a private employer record.

reservoir_ep16_033.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_033.text: The comparison fund had actually spent sixteen so far: eight materials, two initial dispatch and six observation wages. Fourteen remained for the final twelve observation wages and two approved-result dispatch. The physical cover remained unchanged. Yue read the first supported aggregate with the owners at its actual limited review. It could state current collection and cleaning durations and the two offered sleep observations, with no private cause invented. The Ren receiver said it was more careful than she had expected. She still wanted the cover repaired. Yue allowed the compliment and disappointment to remain together.

reservoir_ep16_034.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_034.text: At the end of the review the daughter withdrew one optional margin sentence about her employer. It was not necessary to the accepted interval comparison, and she did not want it retained. Yue removed it from the pending copy and recorded the offered scope rather than preserve the sentence because she had already read it. The role had given her actual access that could narrow when its owner chose. She would continue the four remaining duties within that living consent. A favorable first review did not turn the finite diary into a thing she owned.

reservoir_ep16_035.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_035.text: On Two Hundred Twenty-five, Yue returned to the ordinary practice court after real rest. Deng asked her to describe the difference between observed duration and inferred cause before beginning a modest safe set. She answered from the public lesson without repeating private testimony. Then she grounded, performed the familiar input within the old ceiling and released fully. The comparison role had changed her questions, work and relationships; it had not certified another stage. The later changed-condition trials would still require their own actual quantities, stops and next-day checks after recovered practice.

reservoir_work_maintain.speaker: narrator
reservoir_work_maintain.text: Yue accepted the ordinary maintenance record role. Qiu named its six actual course duty dates and the separate qualified worker's physical task. The Ren receiver signed the accepted fitting and channel plan, while the Liang daughter signed that the project would make no claim about unmeasured sleep. Her private diary remained unavailable. Yue said she wanted to help change the awkward bay and would not request the unselected comparison through friendship afterward. The daughter nodded, disappointed and relieved. The chosen work began by actually closing access Yue had been curious to receive.

reservoir_ep16_037.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_037.text: On Two Hundred Seventeen, the ordinary receiver purchased the accepted eight-copper fitting and channel supplies. The materials arrived under the paid four-copper delivery and passed their actual ordinary receiving checks. Twelve of the separate thirty-copper project purse were now spent, leaving eighteen for the qualified worker's six performed eight-hour days at three each. No household observation forms were purchased, and no anonymous sleep diary entered the project. Yue's own six ordinary record duties remained funded from the course wage line, with no extra pay attached to choosing a physical result.

reservoir_ep16_038.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_038.text: The qualified worker brought his own actual tools and showed Yue which ordinary condition marks he wanted received. She would record materials, physical stages, current operating notices and accepted owner checks within her low-table role. She would not lift the heavier cover, climb to an overhead fixing or replace his qualified method with an untested qi catch. The shared fitting would belong to the bay's owners after acceptance; the tools would leave with him. A useful physical change could occur through ordinary paid competence while the candidate stayed inside her earned range.

reservoir_ep16_039.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_039.text: The daughter came to the desk to withdraw the pending limited diary offer from this finite interval. Yue marked that it had not been received. She did not ask for one private page merely to satisfy her curiosity. The daughter said she still wanted the sleep question answered someday and would consider another actual purpose if offered. Their conversation felt less warm than the shared joke had. Yue had to let the cooler feeling remain without converting it into consent. Maintenance could improve a bay and leave a person's concern genuinely unanswered.

reservoir_ep16_040.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_040.text: On Two Hundred Eighteen, the owners agreed to the actual ordinary work windows outside their current permitted draws. A sound temporary cover and dry waiting route would keep the bay usable when the worker was absent. Each physical change needed its own checked condition before the existing timetable resumed. No extra evening opening had been approved. Yue read the work notice and asked where the current closing point would stand. The worker marked it at ordinary height on the public plan. A safe boundary could be seen without somebody watching every visitor indefinitely.

reservoir_ep16_041.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_041.text: Tian wanted to paint a fish on the temporary closing board. The worker refused because its actual instruction needed to remain unmistakable. Tian painted a fish on his own scrap and offered it to the receiver instead. She accepted after confirming it was a gift and not another official mark. Yue laughed at the modest distinction. The maintenance plan had attracted several ordinary competent people with different tasks. None needed the candidate to become a hero before a board could be clear, a joke could remain affectionate or a tool could stay with its owner.

reservoir_ep16_042.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_042.text: On One Thousand Two Hundred Nineteen, Yue began the first actual eight-hour maintenance-record duty while the qualified worker began his first physical day. The morning record received actual materials and the baseline condition of the old fitting. The worker checked the dry footing before handling the heavier cover through his ordinary method. Yue remained at the low source table and compared each accepted condition mark to its named stage. The two people did different actual work. Their parallel paid day did not make her competent to perform his heavier task tomorrow.

reservoir_ep16_043.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_043.text: During the afternoon, the worker prepared the low replacement fitting's seat and restored the checked temporary cover before the permitted Ren draw. The current timetable remained usable through its accepted ordinary route. Yue received the actual reopening notice and owner condition acknowledgment; she did not replace them with her own impression that the site looked sound. The household's twenty-four litres were collected under the same source mark. A physical project could change preparation while leaving quantities and operating authority intact. The extra eighteen-forty-five opening remained a separate unapproved proposal.

reservoir_ep16_044.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_044.text: The worker completed his accepted eight-hour day and received three coppers from the separate maintenance wage line. Yue completed her own eight-hour record equivalent and received three from the existing course wages after the actual source check. The project had spent fifteen so far: eight materials, four delivery and three qualified work. Fifteen remained for five later actual physical days. No diary had been received, and no observed sleep outcome was attached to the temporary cover. The first paid work stage was real even though the final fitting and channel were not complete.

reservoir_ep16_045.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_045.text: At the evening cleaning, the Ren receiver used the temporary checked condition and said the work felt different but was not finished. Yue wrote that public operating account as offered, without turning it into a measured duration. A new cover preparation might reduce an awkward motion; actual cleaning time had not been compared under the unselected private project. The receiver appreciated the distinction and wanted the completed fitting soon. Yue wanted to hear a simple thank-you and instead received a useful demand to finish the work she had actually accepted.

reservoir_ep16_046.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_046.text: On Two Hundred Twenty, Deng kept the ordinary lesson modest after yesterday's work. Yue reported real fatigue without headache or new shoulder pain. She had spent the day receiving physical condition notices and could feel her attention following the site's unfinished stages. Deng asked her to ground fully before beginning any familiar input. Each ordinary breath remained within the old eighth-unit ceiling. They completed fewer safe sets than she wanted and stopped at the finite end. Important ordinary work did not create extra usable quantity or eliminate its body's need for rest.

reservoir_ep16_047.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_047.text: Fu heard that the daughter had withdrawn the pending diary and asked whether Yue regretted losing it. She did. The maintenance result appealed to her practical hopes, but she still wanted to understand the current sleep account. Fu said regret did not require reopening the owner conversation. Yue agreed and left the private page alone. They ate beans at the garden table while Fu described her brother's song getting slower in the middle. A friendship could include ordinary news beyond the useful testimony somebody had declined to provide.

reservoir_ep16_048.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_048.text: On Two Hundred Twenty-one, the daughter asked Yue why a public maintenance notice said the new fitting would 'ease household rest.' Yue traced the phrase to her own hopeful summary. No sleep evidence had been received under this role, and the owner had expressly reserved that question. Yue removed the unsupported claim and retained only the physical condition it could actually describe. The daughter accepted the correction without approving the earlier choice. Yue had gained a tangible repair and still owed exactness to the person whose unanswered concern its notice had briefly erased.

reservoir_ep16_049.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_049.text: Qiu sent the corrected operating notice to the actual owners before the next work stage. The maintenance project would describe a changed fitting and channel, not private sleep. Yue felt embarrassed because the useful physical effect had tempted her to speak beyond its source. She could correct the phrase in a real conversation rather than bury the mistake beneath a larger claim of service. The daughter kept her diary. The Ren receiver kept the expectation of a finished bay. Neither had to applaud Yue's ordinary correction for it to remain necessary.

reservoir_ep16_050.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_050.text: Tian offered lunch company and asked whether the river onion had acquired a maintenance license. Yue said it had recently made an unsupported sleep prediction and was being returned to ordinary drawing work. Jing advised the onion to stop confusing a dry channel with a comfortable night. They laughed without sharing private testimony nobody had offered. The public lesson was already enough: a measured physical condition could be useful while another human effect remained unknown. Yue ate the actual meal and let the embarrassment become small enough to carry back to the next source.

reservoir_ep16_051.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_051.text: On Two Hundred Twenty-two, the qualified worker checked the accepted material stock for the second physical day. One ordinary fastening had arrived with the wrong length. The supplier confirmed the receiving error and exchanged it within the existing paid order before use. No extra project copper appeared to rescue the estimate, and the wrong piece had not been installed. Yue received the actual exchange condition mark. The correction belonged to competent ordinary procurement. The candidate did not need to invent a qi solution because a small physical object had failed to match its source.

reservoir_ep16_052.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_052.text: The Ren receiver showed the worker where shallow water usually pooled at the exit. Its ordinary public physical scope allowed him to inspect the channel, not the private household's cleaning history. Yue received that exact site observation. The daughter did not attend, and her absence did not make her sleep concern unimportant. She had declined this role's access because it was not the project she had offered. Yue could notice the missing perspective and retain it as missing. Another person's private page was not a gap the maintenance notice must fill to look complete.

reservoir_ep16_053.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_053.text: On Two Hundred Twenty-three, Fu and Yue walked past the bay's current closing board from the sound public path. The temporary condition was usable under its accepted instruction, and the ordinary work would resume tomorrow. Fu said she was glad something physical was happening. Yue agreed and said she still regretted the lost comparison. Fu preferred this plan and did not demand the regret disappear as proof she had chosen sensibly. The ordinary conversation let the selected project remain useful without making the unselected question look like an unnecessary luxury.

reservoir_ep16_054.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_054.text: One Thousand Two Hundred Twenty-four began the second actual maintenance day. The qualified worker cleared the first channel section under the accepted dry work condition, using his own tools and the paid materials. Yue received the baseline and completed-section notices at the low table. The wider exit reduced standing water in that observed section when the current permitted draw resumed. It did not yet certify the whole bay or every later condition. The remaining sections and final fitting still had actual work dates ahead, each requiring its own ordinary source and owner check.

reservoir_ep16_055.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_055.text: During Yue's afternoon record interval, the Ren receiver inspected the first completed section and accepted its physical condition. Her public account said the low exit was easier to use there. Yue kept the statement with its actual place and date, without assigning a sleep gain or a general cleaning-duration improvement. The daughter had offered no diary. The two households retained their current permitted draw timetable. A useful physical result had appeared in one part of the bay, with its scope visible enough that the notice did not need to claim more.

reservoir_ep16_056.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_056.text: The qualified worker completed the second eight-hour day and received three coppers, six actual maintenance wages so far. Yue completed her second eight-hour record equivalent and received three more course wage coppers. The separate project purse had spent eighteen: eight materials, four delivery and six actual qualified work. Twelve remained for four later performed physical days. The candidate's six actually received course wages came from its own existing line. The site had a changed first section, no private sleep observation and real unfinished stages that would occupy the chosen role's remaining dates.

reservoir_ep16_057.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep16_057.text: The daughter visited the bay after its accepted reopening and acknowledged the drier first section. Then she said she wished the morning collection could feel as visibly different. Yue agreed that the present project had not measured or changed that time cost. The woman seemed relieved not to be told the repair had already answered her. She returned home with her diary unavailable to the project. Yue had gained a particular physical outcome and a careful conversation with an unchosen concern, which was more consequential than a universally pleased audience would have been.

reservoir_ep16_058.speaker: narrator
